_comment: ReDesign's tray-host config, read by misc/lunarwerx-tray.exe (source vendored beside it in
misc/tray-host-native/). This file is the whole per-app surface; the host binary is generic and
shared, exactly as ReDesign-Tray.ps1's $TrayConfig hashtable was.
Paths are relative to THIS file unless absolute. %VAR% expands an environment variable,
%VAR|fallback% supplies a default, and a leading ~ is the user profile.
_mutex: {ROOTHASH} = the first 16 uppercase hex chars of SHA-256 over the lowercased resolved root, so
a SECOND CHECKOUT on this machine gets its own tray host instead of colliding on a fixed global
name. The host computes it the same way the PowerShell adapter did, so both agree.
_stray: warn, NOT attach: a live daemon with no tray icon is a headless orphan here, and adopting it
would hide the thing the user has to go and stop.
